duplication_audit.novel_axis: deterministic fixed-weight nonlinear echo-state trajectory summaries over the multichannel past-only context
duplication_audit.distinction: P3 TCN/TimeXer learn encoder weights; NLinear/state-space are linear dynamics; v22 models output residual rank; v26 uses feed-forward interval convolutions; v32 is a Bayesian run-length posterior. v41 learns no recurrent encoder and instead maps the entire causal path through one fixed contractive tanh reservoir before fitting only the strong linear residual head.
duplication_audit.cross_problem_note: P1 v20 used an echo-state detector for a different binary anomaly task; no P1 feature, prediction, threshold, result, or hyperparameter is imported into this independently sealed P3 regression contract.

encoder.input: all 12 transformed historical channels at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.case_standardization: per-channel median and IQR, clip [-8,8], zero-IQR fallback 1

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Jaeger, The echo state approach to analysing and training recurrent neural networks, GMD Report 148 (2001)
primary_sources.use: fixed recurrent reservoir and trained readout mechanism only; not performance evidence
